summary: Verified BUG FIX for /compare 'Error al comparar'. Backend GET /api/compare returns 200 in <1.2s for 6 tickers (AAPL,MSFT,NVDA,GOOGL,AMZN,META), all with valid custom_ratios (poc/pov non-null, missing_inputs=[]). Invalid ticker case: /api/compare?tickers=AAPL,NOSUCHTICKER123,MSFT returns 200 with per-ticker {error} for the invalid one and valid data for the others (no full-request failure). UI /compare renders side-by-side table (Precio, POC, POV, Ratio Compra, Ratio Venta, Señal CARA/BARATA/JUSTA) for all 6 tickers; no 'Error al comparar' toast.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Compare page requires either autocomplete selection or preloading sessionStorage['vs:compare-state']={tickers:[...]} then clicking [data-testid=compare-load]. Backend parallel fetch (asyncio.gather + run_in_threadpool) confirmed fast (<1.2s for 6 tickers via ingress in this run; cache warm). Invalid ticker handled per-item without breaking response.
rca of the issue: Previous /compare version fetched yfinance data serially and skipped cache aggressively → ingress 60s timeout → 502 → frontend showed 'Error al comparar'. Fix (main agent): parallel fetch of missing tickers via asyncio.gather + run_in_threadpool, preserving original order and serving fresh cache. Verified 200 with correct POC/POV for 6 tickers cold+warm; invalid ticker returns per-item error without breaking the batch.
